summary: The customer wants to monitor the concentration of a clear aqueous sucrose solution in-line using a remote analyzer connected via fiber or optics.

facts_stated.text: The solution is clear, colourless and aqueous.
The solution flows through a 50 mm stainless steel pipe.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: flows through a 50 mm stainless steel pipe

facts_stated.text: The expected range is 5 to 15 % w/w.
The quality limit is plus or minus 0.3 % w/w.
A laboratory refractometer is used as the reference method.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Our laboratory refractometer is the reference method

facts_stated.text: The analyser can stand in a dry, safe room 10 m from the pipe.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The analyser can stand in a dry, safe room 10 m from the pipe

facts_stated.text: The line is cleaned in place with hot caustic once a day.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: line is cleaned in place with hot caustic once a day

facts_stated.text: A reading every minute is sufficient.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: A reading every minute is enough
